 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Los Angeles Clippers will face the Lakers without six players Wednesday, limiting their options for the second meeting between the teams this season.
 Bradley Beal, Rui Hachimura , Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller, Yanic Konan Niederhauser and Max Strus were all listed as out on the NBA's 11:30 a.m. PT injury report. The Clippers enter the game at 1-2, with tipoff scheduled for 7:30 p.m. PT at Intuit Dome.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Lakers are playing the second night of a back-to-back. That creates a potential opening for the hosts, but taking advantage will require the available rotation to avoid the mistakes that proved costly in the teams' first meeting.
 Oct 23, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Clippers forward Rui Hachimura (28) shoots the ball against Los Angeles Lakers center Walker Kessler (14) during the fourth quarter at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Kiyoshi Mio-Imagn Images
 Six Absences Reduce the Clippers' Options
 Beal is out for right knee injury management. Hachimura is sidelined by left quadriceps soreness, while Ingram remains out following right heel surgery.
 Miller is unavailable following left rotator cuff surgery. Niederhauser is out following right Lisfranc surgery, and Strus is sidelined by a right plantar fascia tear.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The report confirms their status for Wednesday's game. It does not establish when any of the six will return, and a game designation should not be treated as a recovery timetable.
 For coach Tyronn Lue, the immediate issue is how to distribute responsibilities among the players available. Multiple absences leave less room to adjust when a particular lineup struggles or when foul trouble changes the substitution pattern.
 Oct 23, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Clippers forward Rui Hachimura (28) dribbles the ball against Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) during the fourth quarter at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Kiyoshi Mio-Imagn Images
 My view: The Clippers need to make their remaining combinations easier to play within. Clear offensive responsibilities and decisive movement can help prevent possessions from becoming a series of difficult individual decisions.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement That is especially relevant against an opponent capable of turning a mistake into a quick scoring opportunity. A depleted rotation benefits when it can organize its defense instead of repeatedly scrambling back after a giveaway.
 Doncic's Absence Changes the Defensive Assignment
 Luka Doncic scored 41 points against Portland on Tuesday. His absence removes the Lakers' primary offensive creator and puts greater responsibility on Austin Reaves, who added 26 in that loss.
 The Lakers will be without two starters in Dončić (back soreness) and Ziaire Williams (foot soreness), along with the young prospects Adou Thiero and rookie Cam Carr.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Clippers must adjust to the available personnel rather than expect Friday's matchup to repeat itself. Making Reaves work for his opportunities while staying connected to the players around him becomes a central defensive priority.
 Protecting the basketball remains just as important.
 Oct 23, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Clippers guard Kris Dunn (8) reacts to a play during the fourth quarter against the Los Angeles Lakers at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Kiyoshi Mio-Imagn Images
 The Clippers committed 26 turnovers in the first meeting, and the Lakers converted those mistakes into 33 points. Reducing those opportunities would force a short-handed opponent to generate more offense against a set defense.
 With the Lakers playing for the second consecutive night, defending complete possessions could also benefit the hosts. That requires patience without becoming passive and decisive passing without forcing openings.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Doncic's absence creates an opportunity for the Clippers, but their own injury situation leaves little room for careless execution.
 They can give their available rotation a better chance by limiting turnovers, maintaining defensive communication, and forcing the Lakers to earn their scoring opportunities.
